record.question: The rational for the topical application of fluorides in dental caries prevention is that:
options: Fluorides penetrate the enamel through lamellae
The primary cuticle being less calcified absorbs the fluorides
Acid solubility of the surface enamel is reduced by the fluorides
Keratin content of the enamel is made more resistant to solubility
